title: Molecular docking and experimental validation for the protective effect of betanin against capecitabine-induced myocardial injury: Binding to TLR4 and downregulation of MyD88/NFkappaB signaling.
authors: Saeedi, Tahani A; Hakem, Fady T; Helal, Mohamed A; Mohamed, Marwa Hussein; Khella, Heba W Z; Elbassiouny, Mohamed H; Ismail, Hussein M; Alshahrani, Asma M; Mohamed, Abir S; Saleh, Asmaa; Mohamed, Noura Moustafa; Zaitone, Sawsan A
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接研究甜菜苷与TLR4蛋白结合以缓解心肌损伤，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) is a membrane receptor linked to cardiomyocyte injuries. If activated, TLR4 starts a signaling cascade via recruitment of the myeloid differentiation primary response 88 (MyD88) protein, leading to the phosphorylation of nuclear factor-kappaB (NFkappaB) and production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, which fuels the initiation of the cardiac injury. Betanin is a beet-betacyanin that ameliorates organ toxicities via mitigating the cytokine amplification. Molecular docking was done to test TLR4 as a plausible target for betanin and a bioinformatic search elucidated any potential relationship between betanin and TLR4 pathways including those implicated in inflammatory responses and cardiotoxicity. Further, an experimental study used male albino mice were divided equally into 3 groups as 1) Vehicle, 2) Capecitabine and 3) Capecitabine + Betanin (100 mg/kg/day) groups. Capecitabine (200 mg/kg) was given 5 times a week for 3 weeks. Frozen heart samples were processed for ELISA assays for MyD88/NFkappaB proteins. Formalin-fixed heart samples were used for histopathologic staining using the iron-hematoxylin stain. The bioinformatic analysis confirmed the relationship between myocardial injury and TLR4 signaling. Molecular docking indicated the ability of betanin to block the TLR4 receptors. In the mouse study, betanin mitigated the cardiac histopathological finding, reduced the serum level of cardiac enzymes and downregulated the protein level of MyD88/NFkappaB. This study highlighted that betanin acts as a putative inhibitor for TLR4. Betanin mitigated capecitabine induced myocardial injury and suppressed the TLR4/MyD88/NFkappaB signaling. Hence, betanin was identified as a candidate for further investigation in mitigating myocardial injury.
abstract_zh: Toll样受体4（Toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）是一种与心肌细胞损伤相关的膜受体。一旦被激活，TLR4通过募集髓样分化初级反应蛋白88（myeloid differentiation primary response 88, MyD88）启动信号级联反应，导致核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappaB, NFkappaB）磷酸化及促炎细胞因子产生，从而促进心脏损伤的发生。甜菜红素（betanin）是一种甜菜苷类化合物，通过减轻细胞因子扩增来改善器官毒性。通过分子对接（molecular docking）检测TLR4是否为甜菜红素的潜在靶点，并进行生物信息学搜索以阐明甜菜红素与TLR4通路（包括涉及炎症反应和心脏毒性的通路）之间可能存在的关联。此外，一项实验研究将雄性白化小鼠平均分为3组：1）溶剂对照组、2）卡培他滨组、3）卡培他滨+甜菜红素（100 mg/kg/天）组。卡培他滨（200 mg/kg）每周给药5次，持续3周。冷冻心脏样本用于MyD88/NFkappaB蛋白的ELISA检测。福尔马林固定心脏样本用于铁-苏木精染色的组织病理学染色。生物信息学分析证实了心肌损伤与TLR4信号传导之间的关系。分子对接表明甜菜红素能够阻断TLR4受体。在小鼠研究中，甜菜红素减轻了心脏组织病理学改变，降低了血清心脏酶水平，并下调了MyD88/NFkappaB蛋白水平。本研究强调甜菜红素作为TLR4的推定抑制剂发挥作用。甜菜红素减轻了卡培他滨诱导的心肌损伤，并抑制了TLR4/MyD88/NFkappaB信号通路。因此，甜菜红素被确定为减轻心肌损伤进一步研究的候选物质。
